source: User supplied skill screenshots and explicit scoring instructions

context.killStackRevision: 2026-11-05 user requested zero kills for high-level pushing. This replaces the earlier 100-kill default; elapsed seconds and teleport counts remain independent.
context.duplicateOwner: First deployed copy only; later copies cannot add or replace the buff.
context.scope: Global effects benefit the selected single attacker once; do not multiply by team size.
context.skillTiles: Active and mastery bonuses each multiply by 1.20, using the first owner tile.
context.capturedBaseline: Retains the established no-skill-tile screenshot convention. Captured bonuses include account context and are not rescaled by generic Skill Power, GM, synergy event or map mastery.
context.splash: The original comparison multiplied Templar's active and stacked mastery splash as separate bonuses. Review of the game's ordinary-hit calculation on 2026-11-26 established a single splash factor per ordinary attack, max(1, summed splash percentage / 100). At 20 seconds this capture contributes 1,436% + 824% for ×22.60. Add Warlord's applicable personal splash to the same total.
context.masteryModel: Time, kill and teleport stacks add within each mastery bonus. Druid, Witch and Spelldancer apply separate active and accumulated mastery factors. Templar contributes its accumulated mastery to the ordinary attack's splash percentage.
context.randomModel: Midpoint of each Necromancer range per explicit user answer. This is not an exact expected product of correlated random rolls.

excluded: Movement slow amount, teleport target count and cooldown bonuses do not directly multiply damage; no multi-target or cooldown averaging.
